LG Smart TVs Face Scrutiny Over Potential Privacy Risks

Concerns have been raised regarding the potential for LG Smart TVs to pose privacy risks by recording user activity. Reports suggest that the devices might be capturing conversations and other data within users' homes. LG has reportedly responded to these claims, though the specifics of their response were not detailed in the coverage. The issue highlights broader questions about the privacy implications of internet-connected home appliances.
